rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an immediate, unthinking action or response.

example.english: My first instinctive reaction when I heard someone call me from behind was to turn around.
example.traditional: 我聽到背後有人叫我，第一個下意識咁嘅反應就係回頭望。
example.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 dou3 bui3 hau6 jau5 jan4 giu3 ngo5 dai6 jat1 go3 haa6 ji3 sik1 gam3 ge3 faan2 jing3 zau6 hai6 wui4 tau4 mong6

rows.note: Use this when the behaviour is specifically driven by an innate instinct rather than merely happening automatically.

example.english: A mother's instinctive response when her baby cries is to pick them up immediately.
example.traditional: 嬰兒一喊，媽媽本能嘅反應就係即刻抱起佢。
